name: 本地 PaddleOCR 候选证据提取
purpose: 使用明确指定的本地检测与识别模型，从中文、中英混排或旋转文字图片中提取带多边形位置的候选文本。
eligibility_checks: PaddleOCR and PaddlePaddle are installed locally
detection and recognition model directories are explicit, local, non-empty, and already present
assumptions: the selected local models cover the visible language and image shape
line polygons are candidate locators rather than reviewed reading order
human_gates: visually review critical text and locators
review table structure separately before cell-level claims
sample long-image regions rather than treating one OCR pass as complete coverage
allowed_claims: the local PaddleOCR models produced the located text candidates under the recorded run
forbidden_claims: OCR candidate text is a verified fact
the adapter downloaded or selected a model automatically
successful OCR proves full long-image coverage
